provenance.training_source_commit_note: Original training commits are not recorded in the released archive; null is intentional. Saved args and any source snapshots remain in each checkpoint directory.
provenance.original_seed_source: seed field of the archived args.json, independent of the release directory slot.
provenance.selection: Select the checkpoint matched by the published benchmark; Task-SV selects one merged 14-task result per release slot, excluding per-task duplicates.

known_issues.issue: Some archived MT results use the longest observed episode as the fraction denominator (benchmark_multi_task_mlp.py fallback), not the configured task horizon. The registered overrides preserve the published results and are not task specifications. Fixing the protocol requires re-evaluation/revised results.
